name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: GRU-linked arson plot in Estonia, 14 Nov
summary: Estonia blames Russia's GRU for a 14 Nov arson attempt on a drone maker and closes its Russian border from 1 Dec
state: An attempted arson on Threod Systems, a drone maker in Viimsi, Estonia, took place on 14 Nov; eight Latvian nationals were detained and Estonia's security service attributes the plot to Russian military intelligence (EUobserver, 20 Nov). Estonia decided on 20 Nov to close all land crossings with Russia from 1 Dec. A state-attributed sabotage plot keeps Watch; no sabotage causing casualties or a major outage was found to 26 Nov.
for_you: Defence suppliers and infrastructure operators face elevated sabotage risk. Follow NPSA and police guidance on reporting suspicious activity.
rubric_hit: Sabotage incident attributed to a state = Watch

sources.title: EUobserver — Estonia's border closure makes Russia pay a price for alleged arson

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
